reference_mass_context.qualification: Mass-context provenance only; references do not modify mass. Use the matching isolated environment dry mass override.

contact_schedule.proof: Contact masks are constant between listed phase events; every open event interval has >=3 scheduled supports.

lateral_reference_contract.positive_direction: body translation along episode-left (+Y at initial heading), NOT foot offset
lateral_reference_contract.derivative_units: metres per unit global cycle phase; multiply by actual phase rate for m/s
lateral_reference_contract.phase_alignment: Same phase i/sample_count as joint rows; low/high vectors identical

forward_reference_contract.positive_direction: body translation along episode-forward (+X at initial heading), NOT foot offset
forward_reference_contract.derivative_units: metres per unit global cycle phase; multiply by actual phase rate for m/s
forward_reference_contract.phase_alignment: Same phase i/sample_count as joint rows; low/high vectors identical
forward_reference_contract.startup_stop: Periodic posture transfer only. Scoring of periodic forward displacement/velocity and stop recentering requires explicit future env support; these arrays do not change current reward code.

generation.forward_push_derivation: During support x_body=stance+stroke_phase-body_X and y_body=nominal_y-body_Y; intended body velocity combines +stroke*cadence/duty with the explicit transfer derivatives. Pressure-center rolling/slip is not modelled by center matching.
limitations: Analytical reference only, not loaded contact, whole-COM balance or dynamic validation.
No assets, masses, payload, servo gains or physical limits changed.
Body assumed level; full 3D rotated structural/tread corners are solved.
A stance geometry hypothesis is not a measured calibration.
Periodic bounds do not establish startup/stop or held-packet recovery rates.
Future phase-aware forward reward support is not implemented by this generator.
